track: Track B - Intake Trigger Chain + Jurisdiction

browserToolStatus.details: OpenClaw browser snapshot/open worked, but direct act/fill/type calls timed out or errored. Validation completed via Playwright over the same live CDP browser session instead of looping on broken browser-tool actions.

scope.intent: Designer validation of Track B intake fields and downstream trigger chain
scope.method: Live production walkthrough with CRM paste, downstream auto-fill observation, manual address correction, and re-check of persistence behavior
scope.crmInput:
Lead: Maria Gonzalez
Phone: 520-555-1234
Email: maria.gonzalez@email.com
Project Address: 8880 N Camino Coronado, Tucson, AZ 85704
Notes: existing pool needs resurfacing

headlineFindings: CRM paste still triggers downstream extraction/autofill without an explicit Assign & Sort Data button visible in the current production UI.
Core contact/property fields populated successfully from CRM paste.
Jurisdiction still failed to resolve and remained 'Select jurisdiction'.
Site Intelligence locality copy still conflicts with the canonical address context (shows Oro Valley / Pima County against Tucson address input).
Manual Project Address correction propagated correctly downstream in this run.
Previous overwrite-on-reassign defect could not be revalidated today because the explicit re-assign control was not present in the current production UI.

fieldObservations.expected: Designer can paste raw CRM text and trigger extraction via the documented intake flow.
fieldObservations.observed: Raw CRM paste was accepted. No explicit 'Assign & Sort Data' button was visible in the current production UI, but extraction/autofill still occurred automatically after paste.
fieldObservations.reason: The trigger chain works, but the documented/manual trigger control was absent. That is a designer-facing workflow inconsistency and makes the flow harder to reason about or retest.

fieldObservations.expected: Populate from CRM paste as 'Maria Gonzalez'.
Canonical address should populate clearly and retain the full project address string or otherwise communicate its normalization behavior.
fieldObservations.observed: Field populated as '8880 N Camino Coronado' after CRM extraction, not the full original address line '8880 N Camino Coronado, Tucson, AZ 85704'. Later manual correction to '4828 W Condor Dr, Tucson, AZ 85742' was accepted and retained.
fieldObservations.reason: The chain populates the field, but canonical address presentation is ambiguous/truncated and contributes to location-truth confusion.

fieldObservations.expected: Populate from downstream property/geocode lookup after address resolution.
fieldObservations.observed: Populated as '1,052' after CRM extraction. After manual address correction, updated to '1,403'.

fieldObservations.expected: Populate from downstream property/geocode lookup after address resolution.
fieldObservations.observed: Populated as '1953' after CRM extraction. After manual address correction, updated to '1984'.

fieldObservations.expected: Populate from downstream property/geocode lookup after address resolution.
fieldObservations.observed: Populated as '3.54' after CRM extraction. After manual address correction, updated to '0.34'.

fieldObservations.expected: Populate from geocode result and refresh when canonical address changes.
fieldObservations.observed: Populated as '32.368751' after CRM extraction. After manual address correction, updated to '32.376255'.

fieldObservations.expected: Populate from geocode result and refresh when canonical address changes.
fieldObservations.observed: Populated as '-110.984189' after CRM extraction. After manual address correction, updated to '-111.06802'.

fieldObservations.expected: Resolve jurisdiction from the same downstream location chain or clearly explain why it did not.
fieldObservations.observed: Remained 'Select jurisdiction' after CRM extraction and remained 'Select jurisdiction' after manual correction.
fieldObservations.reason: Track B explicitly includes Jurisdiction. It still does not land.

fieldObservations.expected: Location messaging should align with the canonical project address and jurisdiction outputs.
fieldObservations.observed: Body text still showed conflicting locality language including 'Oro Valley, Pima County' and 'Jurisdiction Oro Valley' while the active address context was Tucson. One body line rendered as a merged/confusing string: '4828 W Condor Dr, Tucson, AZ 85742, Tucson, AZ 85704Pima, Oro Valley(32.3763, -111.0680)↗'.
fieldObservations.reason: This is a designer trust-break. The system presents multiple competing location truths.

fieldObservations.expected: When a designer corrects the canonical address, downstream property and coordinate fields should update accordingly.
fieldObservations.observed: Manual correction to '4828 W Condor Dr, Tucson, AZ 85742' propagated correctly to square footage, year built, lot size, latitude, and longitude.

fieldObservations.field: Manual correction persistence under routine follow-up action
fieldObservations.expected: A designer should be able to test or repeat the intake action without silently losing a manual correction.
fieldObservations.observed: Could not be revalidated today because the explicit 'Assign & Sort Data' control was not present in the current production UI, so the old overwrite path could not be intentionally triggered.
fieldObservations.reason: Not proven safe. The prior overwrite risk is unresolved from a validation standpoint because the regression path is currently untestable through the visible UI.
